item.description:
Location: Kitimat, British Columbia, Canada
Description:

A Master position is available for a tug vessel operating in Kitimat, British Columbia, Canada. The role involves ensuring the safe and efficient operation of the vessel, crew, cargo, and environment. Requirements include Master 3000 Domestic certification (or higher) for Escort tugs, or Master 500 Domestic certification (or higher) for Harbour tugs, along with experience on ASD 60+ Ton Bollard Pull Tugs and knowledge of Canadian maritime legislation and ISM Code. The position offers a full-time, permanent, on-site rotating shift with an hourly rate of $75.17 CAD.



Apply to this job
